description: Model class for a line chart. Provides get/set methods for configuring the chart, its axes, series (line style, markers, area fill, smoothing, stacking), legend, guides, data labels, and temporal binning.

properties.name: _config
properties.description: Current configuration used for the line chart.

properties.name: defaultSeries
properties.description: Default series for the line chart. Used in resetting the series styling.

properties.name: _chartType
properties.description: Literal chart type discriminator for line charts.

properties.name: layerInfo
properties.description: Grouping of layer-related properties to be passed to external functions more compactly.

properties.name: resolveSetup
properties.description: Function that resolves the setup promise.

properties.name: dataStore
properties.description: Data store object that can be used to store any data needed for the chart.

properties.name: setupFinished
properties.description: Promise that resolves when the setup process is complete.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Completes the async setup process for the line chart model. Must be called before using the model.

methods.name: generateDefaultConfig
methods.description: Generates the default config object when creating a new line chart.

methods.name: initDefaultSeries
methods.description: Initializes the default series for the line chart. Used in resetting the series styling.

methods.name: getSeriesLineStyle
methods.description: Gets the line style of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns undefined.

methods.name: setSeriesLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newStyle
params.description: The new style for the series.

methods.name: getSeriesLineWidth
methods.description: Gets the line width of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns undefined.

methods.name: setSeriesLineWidth
methods.description: Sets the line width of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newWidth
params.description: The new width for the series.

methods.name: getSeriesMarkerColor
methods.description: Gets the marker color of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns undefined.

methods.name: setSeriesMarkerColor
methods.description: Sets the marker color of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newColor
params.description: The new color for the series.

methods.name: getSeriesMarkerStyle
methods.description: Gets the marker style of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns undefined.

methods.name: setSeriesMarkerStyle
methods.description: Sets the marker style of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newStyle
params.description: The new style for the series.

methods.name: getSeriesMarkerSize
methods.description: Gets the marker size of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns undefined.

methods.name: setSeriesMarkerSize
methods.description: Sets the marker size of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newSize
params.description: The new size for the series.

methods.name: isLineSmoothed
methods.description: Specify whether line segments of the series should be smoothed. Default false.

methods.name: setLineSmoothed
methods.description: Specify whether line segments of the series should be smoothed.

params.name: smoothed
params.description: true if line segments of the series should be smoothed, false otherwise.

methods.name: isAreaVisible
methods.description: Specify whether the line series should show area. Default false.

methods.name: setAreaVisible
methods.description: Specify whether the line series should show area.

params.name: visible
params.description: true if the line series should show area, false otherwise.

methods.name: isMarkerVisible
methods.description: Indicate whether to show or hide the markers/bullets of the line series. Default true.

methods.name: setMarkerVisible
methods.description: Indicate whether to show or hide the markers/bullets of the line series.

params.name: visible
params.description: true if the markers/bullets of the line series should be shown, false otherwise.

methods.name: getAreaColor
methods.description: Specify the color of the filled area for line chart. areaColor will be applied only if showArea is true, and defaults to the line color if not provided.

methods.name: setAreaColor
methods.description: Specify the color of the filled area for line chart.

params.name: color
params.description: The color of the filled area for line chart.

methods.name: isNegativeValuesStackedToBaseline
methods.description: Specify how negative values are treated in stacked series. If true, negative values are stacked on the base line. If false, negative values are stacked in relation to their previous values in the stack. Default true.

methods.name: setNegativeValuesStackedToBaseline
methods.description: Specify how negative values are treated in stacked series.

params.name: stackNegativeValuesToBaseline
params.description: true if negative values should be stacked on the base line, false otherwise.

methods.name: resetSeriesStyling
methods.description: Resets the series styling to the default styling.

methods.name: resetAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the series styling is able to be reset.

methods.name: getXAxisField
methods.description: Gets the x-axis field for the chart.

methods.name: setXAxisField
methods.description: Sets the x-axis field for the chart. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getAggregationType

methods.name: getDataFilter

methods.description: Sets the data filter for the chart.

methods.name: getCustomSortValues

methods.name: setStackedType
methods.description: Sets how the bars/lines should be placed when multiple series are rendered in the same chart. Default sideBySide.

methods.name: moveSeries
methods.description: Moves a series from one index in the series array to another.

methods.name: moveCustomSortValuesInOrderByList
methods.description: Moves the custom sort values in-place for the order by list in the config.
